name: Rizuhble's Wingman Bebop
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary: sell it later, for Unstoppable.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-7,200 (levels 1-13). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Hyper Beam unlocked. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Compress Cooldown. Ultimate (Hyper Beam) is available from Improved Spirit.

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 6 to Exploding Uppercut's landing damage (0.60x scaling).
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Compress Cooldown completes 4.8k spirit in 6400 souls (~6.4 min), 6 purchases

items.name: Bullet Resist Shredder
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Compress Cooldown completes 4,800 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Compress Cooldown completes 4.8k spirit in 4800 souls (~4.8 min), 5 purchases
items.legacy_note: Hook them in, then uppercut: the landing hit drops their bullet resist for your whole team.

items.name: Extra Health
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Fortitude, 6400 souls (~6.4 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Fortitude, 5600 souls (~5.6 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Trophy Collector
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Fortitude, 4800 souls (~4.8 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 45.2 per second to Hyper Beam's damage per second (2.51x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. Imbued on Grapple Arm: takes 18% off its 23s base cooldown.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 7,200-24,000 (levels 13-27). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Exploding Uppercut T3, Grapple Arm T3. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Fortitude, weapon 4.8k at Hunter's Aura.

items.name: Fortitude
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Extra Health (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Heroic Aura
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Hunter's Aura, 6400 souls (~6.4 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)
items.legacy_note: Only if your team has gun heroes.

items.name: Spirit Strike
items.caption: Builds toward the 6.4k spirit tier, which Spirit Snatch completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Spirit Snatch completes 6.4k spirit in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Spirit Snatch
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 5,600 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 52 spirit power.

items.name: Hunter's Aura
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (3,200 to 6,400 invested, crossing the 4.8k, 6.4k tiers): bonus 18 to 54% weapon damage.
items.legacy_note: Hook them into your team and stay within 15m of them.

items.name: Slowing Hex
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: component_for)

items.name: Veil Walker
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 46 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 24,000-48,000 (levels 27-35). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Hyper Beam T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Sticky Bomb, damage) grows from 327 to 435.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 9,600 to 11,200 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power. | With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 132s; 20% off is 26.5s per full rotation.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 75.3 per second to Hyper Beam's damage per second (2.51x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 11,200 to 16,000 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power. Upgrade of Improved Spirit (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 8,000 to 14,400 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Vortex Web
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: upgrade_of)

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 14,400 to 20,800 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Pop it before you walk in, so they can't stun you out of the hook.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Fortitude? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Veil Walker.
sections.desc: Dying after Fortitude? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Veil Walker.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Grey Talon's charged arrow.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: One gun hero is deleting you: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Knockdown before it lands, Slowing Hex, Disarming Hex.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun and Metal Skin isn't enough.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit: Seven, Infernus, Kelvin, Geist.

items.name: Spirit Rend
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Instead of Heroic Aura when your team has no gun heroes.

items.name: Echo Shard
items.caption: Imbued on Grapple Arm: resets its 11.5s cooldown for a second cast; the shard's own 30s cooldown grows by that ability's cooldown. Takes spirit from 20,800 to 25,600 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power. Replaces Bullet Resist Shredder: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).
items.legacy_note: On Grapple Arm. Sell Bullet Resist Shredder for this.

items.name: Scourge
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 20,800 to 27,200 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power.
items.legacy_note: Cast it on your carry. Sell Trophy Collector for this.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun. Takes vitality from 20,800 to 24,000 invested: bonus 54 to 60 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Sell Fortitude for this, or Dispel Magic if you bought it.

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 132s of base cooldown across your kit, 100s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s. Takes spirit from 20,800 to 27,200 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power. Replaces Veil Walker: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).
items.legacy_note: Sell Veil Walker for this, or Boundless Spirit if a counter took it.

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
